description.value: A 2-for-1 pizza fast food spot serving the Westshore communities of greater Victoria, including Langford, Colwood, and surrounding areas. The online ordering focus and takeout-oriented format makes it a practical stop for cyclists looking for a quick, filling meal. The unit-114 location suggests it sits within a larger commercial or strip-mall complex.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is sparse but functional, confirming the business name and phone number (250-478-2121) match the OSM record. The 'Order Now' call-to-action on the website and the fast_food OSM tag together confirm takeout availability. No address beyond unit number is present in OSM or the website content, and no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the available evidence.
concerns: OSM address is incomplete — only unit number (114) is recorded, no street name or postal code. Full civic address could not be confirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational fast food pizza business serving the Victoria/Westshore area; website is active and phone is confirmed. A useful calorie stop for touring cyclists.
